title: Lucius Antonius
summary: Raleigh names Lucius Antonius in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Lucius Antonius, Lieutenant of the higher Germanie, who was Rebell to Domitian the Emperour, and was slaine. He is not the Antonius who giues Zoan the name Thanis, and not M. Antonius. The one-word title would fold onto Antonius, so the title is two words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
